Class CliopatriaPolityVectorReader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.CliopatriaPolityVectorReader
public class CliopatriaPolityVectorReader extends Object
High-Precision Streaming Ingestor for Seshat / ClioPatria Historical Vector Polities (158 MB GeoJSON). Extracts authentic historical border polygons for any year and rasterizes them directly onto the 2048x1024 cartographic tensor grids.
